title: backup_verify passes having checked nothing; backup liberator has no tests
body:
Found by vc sweep 2026-09-08 (hv/inbox.vc.md), re-confirmed against as-built 2026-09-15.

liberators/backup.sh has zero tests (477 lines, 17 functions) and backup_verify reports PASS without asserting anything in two ways:

- backup.sh:391-394 -- away from MOLT_BACKUP_HOST it prints an info line and returns 0. It also skips the tiles.json checks (share binding, run history), which are LOCAL and need no network. backup_check:263 has the same early return.
- backup.sh:425-440 -- share not mounted (the NORMAL state now that SuperDuper mounts on demand), so dialect and attach-budget checks are skipped, then the unqualified line "Verified: a recent backup exists and the job is bound to its image" prints and the exit code carries nothing.

Fix: always run the local tiles.json assertions; never print an unqualified Verified line or return a plain pass when a check was skipped; add test/liberators/backup.bats whose first control is "verify must not pass when it has not checked anything". Needs env overrides for the tiles.json and scheduler.log paths so fixtures can stand in.
